about: MUTATING — roll deploy/boss to a NAMED build and verify it Ready (infra/forge/rollback-to.sh). The lever the 2026-09-05 outage needed a human's shell for: the classifier blocks the agent's kubectl, the converge's own rollback had rolled to the wrong image, and David was asleep. Authorized by David, 2026-09-05: 'it is obvious we need a lot more ad hoc controls while we are still learning'. The sha names an image the registry holds — read it from `rollout history` or the converge's stamp, never guess. Leaves the stamp and main untouched: a rollback buys time for a fix.
